description: Mainline brush sweep task: use the side of the red brush bristles to sweep a small blue block off the table. The block is spawned near a table edge but away from the tool, and success is measured by the block leaving the tabletop or dropping below the tabletop height.
tool_ref_task_instruction: Use the side of the brush bristles to sweep the object off the table.

scene_initialization.block_position_policy: Seeded edge placement: each seed chooses one tabletop edge and the matching public sweep direction; the block starts randomly along that edge, away from the fixed near-hand tool start pose, so the 20-seed split covers the table perimeter.
scene_initialization.start_pose_policy: Runtime mesh-table-contact projection keeps the brush mesh on the tabletop with 3 mm clearance; xy is fixed near the hand but shifted toward the table center to avoid the hand-side table edge.

acceptance.success_policy: brush_sweep_off_table: a seed succeeds when the dynamic blue block center leaves the tabletop xy bounds or drops below the tabletop height after rollout.
